description: UniFi Poller v2.0.1 Displays detailed information for wireless access points in a UniFi network using Prometheus.

panels.description: Visualize wireless channel usage w/ wired client counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('Ch ', grp) AS channel, value FROM (SELECT grp, count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['mac'] AS mac, Attributes['channel'] AS grp, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_client_uptime_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ap_name'] IN (${AP:singlequote}), $AP) GROUP BY mac, grp) GROUP BY grp ORDER BY value DESC)

panels.title: Clients / Channel

panels.description: Visualize how many clients are connected to which radios/APs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT grp, count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['mac'] AS mac, Attributes['radio_desc'] AS grp, argMax(Value,TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_client_uptime_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['ap_name'] IN (${AP:singlequote}), $AP) GROUP BY mac, grp) GROUP BY grp ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Clients / AP Radio

panels.description: RX is on the negative Axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['name'],' Tx') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_vap_transmit_bytes_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND Attributes['radio']='na' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['name'] IN (${AP:singlequote}), $AP) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['name'],' Rx') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_vap_receive_bytes_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND Attributes['radio']='na' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['name'] IN (${AP:singlequote}), $AP) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: 5 GHz Packets

panels.description: PPS on the ng band calculated in 30 second buckets. In is on the negative Axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['name'],' Out') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_vap_transmit_packets_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND Attributes['radio']='ng' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['name'] IN (${AP:singlequote}), $AP) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(d)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['name'],' In') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_vap_receive_packets_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND Attributes['radio']='ng' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['name'] IN (${AP:singlequote}), $AP) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: 2.4 GHz Drops/Errors

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['source'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_info' AND Attributes['type']='uap' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
list.name: Controller
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['source'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_info' AND Attributes['type']='uap' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['site_name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_info' AND Attributes['type']='uap' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['source'] IN (${Controller:singlequote}), $Controller) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
list.name: Site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['site_name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_info' AND Attributes['type']='uap' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['source'] IN (${Controller:singlequote}), $Controller) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_info' AND Attributes['type'] IN ('uap','udm') AND Attributes['model'] != 'UDMPRO' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
list.name: AP
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='unpoller_device_info' AND Attributes['type'] IN ('uap','udm') AND Attributes['model'] != 'UDMPRO' AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['site_name'] IN (${Site:singlequote}), $Site) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
